intro: Cap what this database may use, and set aside what it must have. Zero means no limit or reservation. Saving only stores them: redeploying is what applies them, and it restarts the database.
invalid: Use a number, 0 or more, and keep any reservation within its limit.
title: Resources
savedHint: Redeploy the database to apply them.
cpuLimitHint: The most CPU it may use, in cores.
cpuReservationHint: CPU set aside for it, in cores.
memoryLimitHint: The most memory it may use, in MB.
memoryReservationHint: Memory set aside for this database, in MB.
